name: gitferry
description: Portable git-change bundles for air-gapped repos: pack unpushed commits, worktree changes, and untracked files into one shareable patch file, then validate and apply it elsewhere.

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/gitferry.cjs && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/gitferry-mcp.cjs
